services.name: Appointment scheduling (real free slots)
services.problem: Customers wait for a call back to get a time; owner juggles a paper or phone calendar
services.competitors: Fresha, Booksy, Zoyya, Calendly, Google Calendar booking pages
services.feasibility: High with an own calendar; integrating a client's existing platform depends on its API
services.risks: Double bookings, wrong hours, owner forgets to block time off

services.name: Appointment reminders
services.problem: No-shows and late cancellations
services.opcost: Email ~0; SMS ~USD 0.14 each to Croatia (Twilio); WhatsApp template fees per message
services.risks: Messaging without consent, wrong time zone, spam complaints

services.name: Missed-call text-back
services.problem: Calls missed while working turn into lost jobs
services.competitors: US tools (e.g. inside field-service suites); few Croatian offers seen
services.feasibility: Medium: needs call forwarding to a virtual number and an SMS or WhatsApp sender
services.opcost: Virtual number plus about USD 0.14 per SMS (Twilio, Croatia)
services.risks: Number porting, carrier rules, cost per SMS

services.name: Website support assistant
services.problem: Same questions asked again and again
services.competitors: Tidio, Intercom, many AI chat widgets
services.opcost: LLM cost under EUR 1/month at small volumes (estimate)
services.risks: Wrong answers stated confidently; small sites get little traffic
services.ai: Optional: retrieval over the FAQ helps with phrasing

services.name: Lead capture and qualification
services.problem: Inquiries arrive half-complete; owner spends time asking the same questions
services.risks: Asking too much and losing the lead
services.ai: Optional: understanding free text; structured forms work without it

services.name: Inquiry classification and routing
services.problem: Mixed inbox: complaints, quotes, spam
services.risks: Misrouted urgent messages
services.ai: Yes for free text, with a human fallback

services.name: Automated email replies (drafts for approval)
services.problem: Slow email replies
services.risks: Sending wrong information if fully automatic
services.ai: Yes, but drafts reviewed by a human

services.name: FAQ assistant
services.problem: Repetitive questions about hours, prices, location
services.competitors: Free chat widgets, WhatsApp Business quick replies
services.risks: Little value on its own
services.ai: Usually no: quick replies and a good FAQ page suffice

services.name: Customer review requests
services.problem: Few Google reviews despite happy customers
services.risks: Review gating and incentives can breach platform rules

services.name: CRM updates
services.problem: Customer details scattered across phone, WhatsApp, notebooks
services.risks: Duplicate or wrong records

services.name: Invoice and payment reminders
services.problem: Late payments
services.competitors: Invoicing software; e-invoicing services under Fiskalizacija 2.0
services.risks: Financial data; reminders to wrong people; collection rules

services.name: Customer onboarding flows
services.problem: New clients need documents, instructions, forms
services.risks: Collecting more data than needed

services.name: Quote generation (instant price range)
services.problem: Every inquiry waits for a manual quote; slow quotes lose jobs
services.risks: A quoted range the business will not honour; must say 'estimate, confirmed after inspection'
services.ai: No for the price (rules); optional for reading free-text descriptions

services.name: Document processing
services.problem: Manual data entry from invoices and forms
services.risks: Errors in financial data; sensitive data

services.name: Inventory notifications
services.problem: Running out of stock
services.risks: Bad data in, bad alerts out

services.name: Internal reporting
services.problem: Owner lacks a weekly overview
services.risks: Nobody reads the report

services.name: Quote and sales follow-ups
services.problem: Quotes sent and never chased
services.risks: Too many follow-ups annoy customers; needs consent rules

services.name: Customer feedback collection
services.problem: No structured feedback
services.risks: Low response rates

services.name: Social-media inquiry management (Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger)
services.problem: Inquiries scattered over DMs, lost in personal inboxes
services.competitors: Meta Business Suite inbox (free), unified-inbox tools
services.feasibility: Medium: official Meta APIs need business verification and app review
services.opcost: WhatsApp template messages are charged per message
services.risks: Account restrictions if rules are broken; no unofficial automation

services.name: Automated business dashboards
services.problem: No overview of bookings and revenue
services.risks: Low perceived value for very small firms

services.name: Rebooking reminders for repeat services
services.problem: Customers who should come back (e.g. every 3-6 months) forget
services.risks: Marketing messages need prior consent (ZEK Art. 50)

services.name: Deposits and prepayment links against no-shows
services.problem: No-shows on long or expensive jobs
services.risks: Refund disputes; handling payments raises the stakes
